Veteran Marathi Theatre Director Vijaya Mehta Dies at 91 or 92

Vijaya Mehta, a prominent figure in modern Marathi theatre known for her work as a director, actor, and producer, has passed away. Reports indicate her age at the time of death was either 91 or 92. She is remembered for her significant contributions that transformed the landscape of Indian theatre.
